$comment: Static urgent messages (FR-05, PRD 9.2/9.3, ADR-004). The model never writes or edits these. English is the master; every other language is derived from this file. 'uncertain' uses the 'urgent' message. Phone numbers and hrefs must stay byte-identical in every language. DRAFT until the clinical adviser approves.

emergency.title: This could be an emergency
body: What you have described could be serious.
Do not wait to see if it gets better.
This app cannot check symptoms or give medical advice.
emergency.banner: You told us something that could be an emergency. If you have not already, call 999 now.

urgent.title: Please get help soon
body: What you have described may need a health professional to look at it soon.
Contact NHS 111 now, by phone or online, or call your GP surgery if it is open.
If it gets worse, or you think it is an emergency, call 999.
This app cannot check symptoms or give medical advice.
urgent.banner: You told us something that may need help soon. If you have not already, contact NHS 111 or your GP surgery.

crisis.title: You do not have to face this alone
body: It sounds like you are going through something very hard right now.
You can talk to Samaritans for free, any time, day or night. Call 116 123.
If you are in immediate danger, or you might act on these thoughts, call 999 now.
You can also call NHS 111 for urgent mental health help.
crisis.banner: You told us you may be going through something very hard. Samaritans are there any time on 116 123. If you are in immediate danger, call 999.
